capabilities: Outline chapters and scene beats in a sidebar
Set word goals, sprints and writing stages
Flag echoes, adverbs and long sentences with a revision lens
Keep cut passages and note snapshots for restore
Export manuscripts to DOCX, EPUB and PDF
disambiguation: Not a general writing or grammar assistant; it is a workspace for planning, revising and exporting fiction manuscripts.
extras: No network access, no AI and no telemetry; each feature can be switched off on a Features page; guides are in English and Brazilian Portuguese; requires Obsidian 1.13 or later.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to plan scenes, track drafting goals, review a draft and export a manuscript, so fiction writers have to assemble several separate tools.

relations.evidence: Escrita is inspired by NEO by Hugh Howey (MIT License).

summary: Fiction-writing workspace with an in-chapter outline, word goals, a revision lens, a shared story world and manuscript export to DOCX and EPUB.
